argv: A moment of a walk still open is not offered by the picker
answered by threading-at-capture TK6 (decision 0253): the picker reads poolWithOpenWalks; a thread of the walk still open was listed since fix thread-in-walk

ops.body: - **Add to a thread's search rebuilds its items on each keystroke** (threading-at-capture audit 6): every moment's context line is formatted again per keystroke, now from the first step's search too, and the thread rows cost threads × members. Fine at hundreds; with thousands of moments, build the picker's items once per pool and index members by thread.

- [ ] **Do:** on a walk, on an iPhone and an Android phone, photograph something, close the editor, tap the pill's link mark (Thread), then A new thread, pick the photo before it by its picture, type a name and Done; photograph a third and tap Thread, then the first row; then do the same on Navigate, ready. At 320 pt, look at the pill. **Expect:** the card opens over the screen, its search closed until tapped; the walk's earlier photo is offered with its small picture; the name field takes the keyboard and the card stays above it; Done keeps the name; the third joins under "Last added to" with "Connected" said once; Back (Android) and closing leave the pill and the capture stack as they were; at 320 pt the pill's × sits on a second row, nothing cut. (TK1-TK10)
